heading: Apps by Wishissue
intro: Pick an app and tap Get. Downloads come straight from GitHub, and you don't need an account.

apps.tagline: Frame-by-frame 2D animation for Android. Free, with no ads.

apps.name: Wishi Files
apps.tagline: A tiny, private file manager for Android TV and phones.
apps.about: Browse storage, send files to and from any phone over your home Wi-Fi, and inspect APKs before you install them. No ads, no accounts, no cloud, and the whole app is under 200 KB.
